verses.1: You shall not make for yourselves any idols or sacred objects. You shall not establish any shrines for them. Nor shall you set up stones as altars in your land, so that you may worship them. For I, the LORD your God, am your God.
verses.2: You shall keep my commandments, and you shall fear my holy things. I am the LORD.
verses.3: If you obey my laws and keep my commandments, then do these things.
verses.4: And I will give you your crops at the right time. The land will become fertile, and the trees in the fields will bear fruit.
verses.5: And He provided for you with food to eat. And from that food, you will produce seeds. Then you will eat your meals until they are finished, and then you will sit down in peace in your land.
verses.6: And I will give peace to the land, and you shall lie down in safety. There will be no more destruction or chaos in your land.
verses.7: And they pursued their enemies, and fell before you, to be destroyed.
verses.8: And five hundred of them were pursued by more than a hundred men. They fell before your eyes, to be destroyed.
verses.9: And I turned to you and blessed you. I increased your numbers, and I established my covenant with you.
verses.10: And you shall eat raw bread, and also raw meat from new animals.
verses.11: And I will make my dwelling among you, and my soul will not be displeased with you.
verses.12: And I went into their midst, and I became your God. And you will become my people.
verses.13: I, Jehovah your God, have brought you out of the land of Egypt, from being their slaves. I will free you from your bondage, and I will lead you away with joy.
verses.14: And if you do not listen to me, and do not follow all these commands.
verses.15: And if you disobey my laws, and if you refuse to obey my judgments, then I will break my covenant with you.
verses.16: I will do this for you. I will assign you a task: to plant your seeds with my own eyes, and with my own hands. Then I will eat up your enemies.
verses.17: And I will face you with my face, and you will be humiliated before your enemies. Your enemies will laugh at you, but there is no one who can harm you.
verses.18: And if you still do not listen to me, then I will punish you seven times over your sins.
verses.19: And I broke your crowns, and I gave you your names as worthless. And I made your land a wasteland.
verses.20: And your strength will be wasted, and your land will not produce any fruit. The trees on the earth will not bear any fruit either.
verses.21: And if you go with me, I will punish you seven times over your sins. You will not be able to listen to me, and I will bring upon you great punishment.
verses.22: And I sent upon you the life of the wilderness, and I made you homeless. I destroyed your homes, and I made your ways difficult for you.
verses.23: And if you do not obey me in these matters, then go with me.
verses.24: And I also went with you in your journey. I took you along with me, and I punished you for your sins.
verses.25: And I will bring upon you punishment as retribution for your sins. I will gather you together in your cities, and I will send a plague upon you. You will be given into the hands of your enemies.
verses.26: In your bread, I will give you enough food. And I will also provide you with twelve women who will serve as your helpers. They will be responsible for preparing the food for you. You can eat freely, without any worries.
verses.27: And if you still do not listen to me, then go with me into the wilderness.
verses.28: And I went with you in the heat of summer. I punished you for your sins.
verses.29: And you shall eat with your own flesh and with the flesh of your daughters.
verses.30: And I will honor your bones. I will remember your suffering. I will place your carcasses on the carcasses of your ancestors. And I will mourn for you.
verses.31: And I will give your cities into ruin, and I will destroy your holy places. I will not let your fragrance be heard anymore.
verses.32: And I will fill the earth with you, and your descendants will dwell upon it.
verses.33: And I will scatter you among the nations. I will destroy your cities, and your land will become desolate. Your cities will be turned into ruins.
verses.34: Then the earth will desire to rest in its peace, all days long. And you will be in your own land. Then the earth will rest, and it will desire to be at peace.
verses.35: Every day, you must rest what you haven’t rested during your nights.
verses.36: And those who remained among you, I brought them back to their own lands. They were pursued by a voice that shrieked loudly. They tried to escape from the clutches of destruction, but they fell down, and no one could save them.
verses.37: And when one person fails in his brother’s place, it is like a disaster. There will be no hope for you before your enemies.
verses.38: And you died in the countries, and the land of your enemies ate you up.
verses.39: And those who remain among you will be scattered across your lands. Even in the lands of their ancestors, they will still be scattered.
verses.40: And they bowed their heads in worship before their ancestors, in that heaven that is above me. And they also went with me through all the hardships that I faced.
verses.41: I will go with them in their journey, and I will bring them to the land of their enemies. Then their hearts will be filled with fear, and they will desire to return home.
verses.42: And I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and even my covenant with Abraham. The land also remembers these covenants.
verses.43: And the land will abandon them, and it will destroy their crops in its wrath. They will hate their own gods, because they have broken my laws and violated my commandments.
verses.44: And yet, even when they were in their own land, they did not break my covenant with them. They did not go against it at all. This is because I am the LORD their God.
verses.45: And I remembered them with a covenant of the first ones. I brought them out of Egypt before the eyes of the nations, so that they might become their gods. I am Jehovah.
verses.46: These are the laws, decrees, and ordinances that Jehovah gave to him and to the children of Israel on Mount Sinai, through Moses’ hands.
